about_the_game:
Marisa sold all her magical props for money in order to play 'Kappachinko', but ultimately lost nothing!

Marissa, who had stolen all over Fantasia, was chased by unknown people and had to join the recent popular magic item battle in Gansokyo...

However, Marissa will not give up!

With her excellent intuition for magical props (as well as the malicious loans of Reimu), she will defeat all opponents in battle and use all the money she steals to repay her debts!

However, if we fail in the battle, welcoming Marissa may not be a good thing...

GAMEPLAY

You will play the role of Marissa, collect various items and combine them within ten days, and use these item combinations to welcome the battle at night!

In a complete game of about 20 minutes, you will face a large number of choices, such as purchasing items, exchanging money, acquiring skills, etc., and gradually forming your own structure.

In the end, you will be mercilessly tested by the enemy, and if you fail to win, you will have to accept punishment

ITEMS&SKILLS

The game has over 120 items and over 40 skills, allowing players to freely combine them!

In each game, you can obtain different items and skills, unleash your imagination, and combine various powerful lineups!

In addition, you can occasionally change the effects of some items, thus developing paths that even the production team never imagined!

MORE THING

After playing several games, you can activate Extra mode to challenge your past history!

However, only historical records at the highest difficulty level are eligible to enter the matching pool, and as the number of victories increases, you will face increasingly brutal battle environments

There are still many little secrets waiting for you to discover!

Welcome join the QGroup 1062830120 for discussing！

  • OS: Windows8
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 10100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Marisa lost all of her family fortune in 'Kappachinko', yet it sparked a trend in Gensokyo of fighting with magical items! Collect items and skills, carefully combine and place them, and challenge various powerful enemies! In the end, you might even encounter unexpected mysterious beings...
